request: With --crlf and --replace together, normalize every matched line terminator to \r\n even if it originally used only \n, so our Windows export pipeline gets uniform endings.

source.request: With --crlf and --replace together, normalize every matched line terminator to \r\n even if it originally used only \n, so our Windows export pipeline gets uniform endings.
source.settled: Replacement with --crlf preserves existing line terminators instead of converting LF endings to CRLF.
source.why: Normalizing existing LF endings to CRLF reverses the terminator-preservation fix.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
